# ux.sgit.ai: UX, measured

> Where the sgit.ai sites, and the browsers and platforms they are read on, fail their readers, measured, and what fixes it. A register of UX failures and gaps across the sgit.ai sites, each measured on the
> live site with a date and version, the principle it breaks, the fix, and (where one exists) a working
> prototype of the fix in three design directions.

Site version: v0.2.0 (2026-10-18). Content CC BY 4.0. Code Apache 2.0. Author: Dinis Cruz, with AI co-authorship.

## The headline

57 findings across 4 products: 51 still open, 13 of them high severity, 6 fixed. 38 are failures (something works against the reader) and 19 are gaps (something the reader needs is not there). Every count on this site is generated from /data/findings.json.

## Properties agents may rely on

- /data/findings.json is the register. Every finding page, list, filter and count is generated from it at build, and the gate fails if a page is stale.
- Every finding has a stable page at /findings/<ID>.html and a markdown twin at /findings/<ID>.md.
- Every page has a markdown twin: replace .html with .md, or append index.md to a directory URL.
- /findings/?product=&area=&problem=&visibility=&recommendation=&principle=&severity=&status=&kind=&q= is a linkable filter (comma-separate values for OR). /browse/ lists every value of every facet with its count.
- /data/taxonomy.json defines the problem, visibility and recommendation vocabularies; /data/site.json defines the products.
- Statuses carry the date and version they were last checked. Nothing here claims to be current beyond that date.
- /llms-full.txt is the whole site in one fetch.

## The pages

/about/  (/about/index.md)
  Who writes ux.sgit.ai, why the register is public, what it is not, and the licences.
/admin/  (/admin/index.md)
  How ux.sgit.ai is built and checked: the source files, the build, the gate, and what CI enforces.
/admin/versions.html  (/admin/versions.md)
  The release history of ux.sgit.ai: each version, its date, what it changed and the files it touched.
/browse/  (/browse/index.md)
  Every index of the register in one place: by product, area, problem, visibility, recommendation, principle, severity, status and kind, each value with its count and a link to the filtered list.
/findings/  (/findings/index.md)
  The register: every UX failure and gap found on the sgit.ai sites, with status, severity, the principle it breaks and the fix. Filterable, and every filter is a link.
/  (/index.md)
  A register of where the sgit.ai sites fail their readers, measured on the live site with a date and a version, the principle each failure breaks, the fix, and a working prototype of it.
/lab/  (/lab/index.md)
  Four encrypted vaults that try the newsroom review's fixes as working prototypes, on the real newsroom data, in three design directions each, before anything changes on the live site.
/method/  (/method/index.md)
  How a UX finding is made here: the reader's path, the stranger test, the review panel, what severity and status mean, and how to file a finding in the register.
/principles/  (/principles/index.md)
  The rules the findings break, each with why it matters, a one-minute test you can run on any page, and the findings that break it.
/reviews/  (/reviews/index.md)
  The full UX reviews the findings come from, published whole, with their date, the version reviewed and the method.
/reviews/newsroom-2026-10-11.html  (/reviews/newsroom-2026-10-11.md)
  The UX review of newsroom.sgit.ai (v0.6.4, re-checked on v0.7.1) that seeded this site's register: first visit, findability, the article and its feedback, personas, reader primitives, the publishing pipeline and a roadmap.

## The findings

/findings/UX-001.html  [open, high, newsroom.sgit.ai, buried-content+builder-chrome, obvious, cut-to-the-essential] The first phone screen explains how the site is built, not what it is about
/findings/UX-002.html  [open, high, newsroom.sgit.ai, overload, obvious, cut-to-the-essential] The home page is 59 phone screens long, with 845 links
/findings/UX-024.html  [open, high, newsroom.sgit.ai, preselected-input, subtle, start-empty] All three rating scales start on 3
/findings/UX-025.html  [open, high, newsroom.sgit.ai, missing-channel, silent, open-a-channel] Ratings never reach the author
/findings/UX-028.html  [open, high, newsroom.sgit.ai, unlabelled, obvious, say-what-it-is] The £5.00 balance chip has no label
/findings/UX-029.html  [open, high, newsroom.sgit.ai, silent-change+unlabelled, subtle, say-what-it-is] Opening an article charges a penny with no notice
/findings/UX-032.html  [open, high, newsroom.sgit.ai, missing-signal, silent, show-it-up-front] Nothing shows real money moving
/findings/UX-033.html  [open, high, newsroom.sgit.ai, missing-signal, silent, show-it-up-front] It is unclear how a writer gets paid
/findings/UX-034.html  [open, high, newsroom.sgit.ai, missing-channel, obvious, open-a-channel] No contact for a pilot on the Replicate page
/findings/UX-037.html  [open, high, newsroom.sgit.ai, inconsistent-facts, silent, generate-from-one-source] Two domains claim to be canonical for the same article
/findings/UX-044.html  [open, high, newsroom.sgit.ai, hidden-until-script+dead-end, intermittent, render-on-first-load] The founder page says "the picks above" and no picks render on a phone
/findings/UX-046.html  [open, high, dev.vault.sgraph.ai, host-trap+dead-end, silent, design-for-the-host] Setting location.hash inside a vault app re-navigates the frame: every link silently dead
/findings/UX-056.html  [open, high, firefox-ipad, focus-hijack+unexpected-movement+wrong-culprit, intermittent, keep-the-ui-still] Scrolling back up a little puts focus in the address bar and opens the keyboard
/findings/UX-003.html  [open, medium, newsroom.sgit.ai, missing-signal, subtle, show-it-up-front] The masthead line describes a method, not a subject
/findings/UX-004.html  [open, medium, newsroom.sgit.ai, stale-claim, subtle, date-the-claim] The edition label is older than the articles under it
/findings/UX-008.html  [open, medium, newsroom.sgit.ai, hidden-until-script, intermittent, render-on-first-load] Content is hidden until JavaScript runs
/findings/UX-009.html  [open, medium, newsroom.sgit.ai, overload+builder-chrome, obvious, move-to-the-workshop] Two navigation bars, and a 60-link menu that mixes reading with building
/findings/UX-010.html  [open, medium, newsroom.sgit.ai, dead-end, intermittent, build-the-way-in] Missing pages show the default GitHub Pages 404
/findings/UX-013.html  [open, medium, newsroom.sgit.ai, overload, subtle, build-the-way-in] One topic holds more than half the articles
/findings/UX-014.html  [open, medium, newsroom.sgit.ai, dead-end, obvious, make-it-a-link] Tags are not links, and there are no tag pages
/findings/UX-015.html  [open, medium, newsroom.sgit.ai, unshareable-view, silent, make-it-a-link] Filters cannot be shared
/findings/UX-016.html  [open, medium, newsroom.sgit.ai, missing-way-in, silent, build-the-way-in] Series are invisible
/findings/UX-017.html  [open, medium, newsroom.sgit.ai, missing-way-in, subtle, build-the-way-in] There is no "start here" path
/findings/UX-018.html  [open, medium, newsroom.sgit.ai, missing-signal, subtle, show-it-up-front] Cards do not show reading time or format
/findings/UX-020.html  [open, medium, newsroom.sgit.ai, buried-content, obvious, show-it-up-front] The best reader feature is buried under metadata and a long italic abstract
/findings/UX-022.html  [open, medium, newsroom.sgit.ai, missing-signal, subtle, show-it-up-front] The byline names one human; the AI authorship is in the footer
/findings/UX-023.html  [open, medium, newsroom.sgit.ai, missing-signal, silent, build-the-way-in] There is no page that says why the publication exists
/findings/UX-027.html  [open, medium, newsroom.sgit.ai, unconsented-state, subtle, ask-first] Articles join the reader's list without being asked
/findings/UX-030.html  [open, medium, newsroom.sgit.ai, alarming-wording, subtle, say-what-it-is] "Credit can go below zero" reads as a debt
/findings/UX-038.html  [open, medium, newsroom.sgit.ai, inconsistent-facts, subtle, generate-from-one-source] Three different article counts
/findings/UX-043.html  [open, medium, newsroom.sgit.ai, unconsented-state, silent, ask-first] Opening a persona link adds it to the browser without asking
/findings/UX-045.html  [open, medium, newsroom.sgit.ai, missing-signal, subtle, build-the-way-in] Persona pages are a list, with no story, opinion or next step
/findings/UX-047.html  [open, medium, dev.vault.sgraph.ai, host-trap+data-loss, intermittent, design-for-the-host] localStorage throws inside the vault app frame, so reader data is lost on reload
/findings/UX-057.html  [open, medium, firefox-ipad, unexpected-movement+lost-screen-space, obvious, keep-the-ui-still] The toolbars come back on any small scroll up, taking screen and moving the page

/findings/UX-007.html  [open, low, newsroom.sgit.ai, missing-signal, subtle, write-for-a-stranger] The editor's note is written for someone who read the last two editions
/findings/UX-011.html  [open, low, newsroom.sgit.ai, dead-end, silent, check-at-build] Links without extensions in one article
/findings/UX-012.html  [open, low, newsroom.sgit.ai, overload, subtle, cut-to-the-essential] Each article ends with seven next steps instead of one
/findings/UX-019.html  [open, low, newsroom.sgit.ai, missing-way-in, subtle, build-the-way-in] Search only matches titles, teasers and tags
/findings/UX-021.html  [open, low, newsroom.sgit.ai, builder-chrome, obvious, move-to-the-workshop] Author tooling is shown to every reader
/findings/UX-026.html  [open, low, newsroom.sgit.ai, missing-channel, silent, open-a-channel] There is no way to say what was missing
/findings/UX-031.html  [open, low, newsroom.sgit.ai, alarming-wording, subtle, say-what-it-is] "You pay the price" reads as a warning
/findings/UX-039.html  [open, low, newsroom.sgit.ai, inconsistent-facts, subtle, generate-from-one-source] The feed is titled for the old site
/findings/UX-040.html  [open, low, newsroom.sgit.ai, stale-claim, subtle, date-the-claim] The study page reports a fixed bug as current
/findings/UX-048.html  [open, low, dev.vault.sgraph.ai, host-trap, silent, design-for-the-host] A vault app can load images and scripts from a site but cannot fetch its data
/findings/UX-049.html  [open, low, dev.vault.sgraph.ai, host-trap+unshareable-view, silent, design-for-the-host] Query strings break inside the vault host, so filters must live in the route path
/findings/UX-052.html  [open, low, newsroom-design-lab, data-loss, subtle, say-what-it-is] A highlight across paragraphs is cut at the first paragraph
/findings/UX-053.html  [open, low, newsroom-design-lab, missing-signal, subtle, show-it-up-front] Search results show no snippets
/findings/UX-054.html  [open, low, newsroom-design-lab, unlabelled, obvious, say-what-it-is] Stacked tables on a phone lose their column labels
/findings/UX-055.html  [open, low, newsroom-design-lab, untested-path, silent, test-where-readers-are] "Ask the article" has never run against a real on-device model
/findings/UX-035.html  [fixed, high, newsroom.sgit.ai, inconsistent-facts+alarming-wording, obvious, say-what-it-is] The top-up page said "simulated" while asking for money
/findings/UX-036.html  [fixed, high, newsroom.sgit.ai, inconsistent-facts, silent, generate-from-one-source] Articles were published on two domains, and diverged
/findings/UX-041.html  [fixed, high, newsroom.sgit.ai, dead-end, obvious, check-at-build] 51 vault images missing across 10 articles
/findings/UX-042.html  [fixed, high, newsroom.sgit.ai, missing-way-in, silent, build-the-way-in] Persona links were designed but not live
/findings/UX-050.html  [fixed, medium, newsroom-design-lab, layout-overflow, obvious, check-at-build] File-path pills scrolled the whole page sideways at 390 px
/findings/UX-051.html  [fixed, medium, newsroom-design-lab, unexpected-movement, obvious, keep-the-ui-still] Re-rendering the whole view on every save lost the reader's place
